task_instance: Run the ai-debt-detector checklist audit on a freshly AI-generated Node.js module (a report-uploader with uploader.js and package.json) and produce a findings report covering failure modes, orphaned resources, edge cases, hallucinated dependencies, and architectural drift.
evidence: Created sample/ (package.json + src/uploader.js) seeded with the exact AI debt patterns the skill targets. Audited per the skill's five categories and verified each finding with runtime/static checks: (1) node load attempt failed with 'Error: Cannot find module node-fetch', proving the hallucinated/missing dependency breaks load; grep showed require('resilient-fetch') is imported but absent from package.json dependencies [node-fetch]. (2) grep found swallowed error 'catch (e) {}' at line 35 and AI punt '// TODO: handle error' at line 40 (skill red flags). (3) grep confirmed opened resources (process.on progress listener, createReadStream, pool.getConnection) with ZERO matching removeListener/close/release/finally cleanup -> orphan/leak findings. (4) identified undeclared free variable 'pool' (ReferenceError at call time) and unguarded JSON.parse/stream error (no reject) edge cases. Deliverable written to audit_findings.md (a structured, category-by-category debt report with line references and a do-not-merge verdict) at work dir. The skill is a methodology/checklist with no bundled scripts; its core deliverable is the targeted audit report, which was produced and each claim verified with real tooling.
